title: Group existing backlog outcomes and record genuine prerequisites
outcome: Group existing backlog outcomes and record genuine prerequisites
acceptance: Existing open tasks are inspected and organized into outcome groups without changing acceptance, ownership, or parent/child completion obligations.
Final readback verifies grouping, dependency direction and retained task contracts.
Genuine prerequisite edges are recorded with reasons; existing waits and independent work are preserved.
